operation: Documentation and archived-data verification only; no new GPU experiment or live runtime check.

single_stream.operation: Recompute archived results; no new inference benchmark and no live service verification.
single_stream.hardware: 4 x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition, TP=4
single_stream.cache: radix/prefix cache disabled; service and kernels warmed
single_stream.mtp: EAGLE path; fixed 3 steps, top-k=1, 4 draft tokens

metrics.mean_output_tok_s: Arithmetic mean over 3 native benchmark windows of actual total output tokens / native duration; includes prefill and decode. Four-GPU service total, not per GPU.
metrics.mean_tpot_ms: Native SGLang TPOT = (E2E - TTFT) / (actual output tokens - 1), averaged within and then across rounds.
metrics.reciprocal_mean_tpot_tok_s: 1000 / mean TPOT in ms. A derived rate; not the arithmetic mean of per-request rates and not guaranteed identical to AIPerf generation TPS.
metrics.aggregation: Each primary row preserves one workload, one mode, and three independent rounds; no cross-workload or replay pooling.

independent_corpus_replay.limit: Different prompt corpus; a single segment of a segmented replay, excluded from the three-round baseline.

limitations: No matched 8K-input/1024-output C1 measurement against the peer report.
Do not infer a framework ranking from different model revisions, workloads, cache settings, or averaging methods.
Reciprocal TPOT does not establish GPU compute time or a hardware roofline percentage.
Saved acceptance records describe their measurement time and are not proof of current runtime health.

limits: Research latency targets, not externally confirmed production SLOs.
Only deterministic 30-second arrival windows at 4,7,9 req/s; no production P99 guarantee or unmeasured maximum-capacity claim.
Finite-window native goodput includes final drain; good/30s is a separately named offered-window rate.
All modes instrumented equally; no gain is inferred against the earlier uninstrumented study.
The common 32 in-flight admission bound records rejections as failures; it does not defer clients.
